usedFor: Shopify holds orders and products, and EasyPost receives a parcel record through “Create a parcel” after each “New Product”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create a parcel” in EasyPost
bestTemplate.why: A new product creates a parcel with weight and size, so shipping data is ready for the first order.

watchOut: “Create a parcel” takes weight, length, width and height where they apply, so map them from the product.
